messages:
mike: quick heads-up — saw a weird p95 spike for qwen-32k on apac-h100 this morning. latency looks fine p50-ish but p95 jumps ~3x around seq>8k.
anya: ugh, same job in eu a100 is stable. do you have the kernel selection logs?
simon: the runtime should pick rope-gqa-fused for qwen-32k. if it falls back to generic matmul you get that p95 blowup.
mike: I pulled the logs, it shows a fallthrough: 
```
kernel_select: model=qwen-32k arch=h100 region=apac kernel=rope-gqa-fused -> error -> fallback=generic-matmul
reason: missing kernel for seqlen>8192 on compiled image
```
anya: that error text rings a bell — we had a build variant for apac images that omitted a gqa kernel due to a compile flag (CUDA_SM mismatch).
priya: can we repro quickly with a microbench? bench-bot, can you run the kernel-probe script on apac-h100 and eu-a100 for qwen-32k, batch=4, seq=12k?
bench-bot: running probe 2222223333: `./tools/kernel_probe --model qwen-32k --seq 12000 --batch 4 --profile-kernel` -> ETA ~90s
bench-bot: results (apac-h100): p50=34ms p95=268ms kernel_used=generic-matmul
bench-bot: results (eu-a100): p50=31ms p95=59ms kernel_used=rope-gqa-fused
simon: confirmed — apac image fell back. likely a build-time sm_arch filter. that explains region delta.
anya: is this new after the recent runtime upgrade? we AV-fed a newer kernel selection contract last week.
mike: last deploy for apac was a patched runtime image (id: rt-2026-03-12) that differs from eu (rt-2026-03-08).
priya: simple workaround: force-route qwen-32k on apac to eu (latency tradeoff) or re-build apac runtime with full kernels.
simon: quick patch idea: add a kernel fallthrough telemetry to alert earlier. also add a canary job that probes seq buckets.
anya: agree. for immediate relief I can trigger a rebuild with sm_arch=80/90 flags included. ETA ~2h.
mike: thanks. can someone add a short postmortem note to the onboarding doc for qwen-32k pointing to this kernel sensitivity? helps future bring-ups.
priya: will do. adding note: "qwen-32k requires rope-gqa-fused compiled for target SMs; missing kernel => generic fallback with large p95 regressions"
mike: also file a tickets: infra-image(apac) and runtime-telemetry. assigning simon + anya.
simon: on it.
anya: tag: @infra-team @runtime — FYI. :wave:
deploy-bot: scheduled rebuild job started: job_id=rb-2222223333-01 image=rt-2026-03-12 target=apac-h100
bench-bot: when rebuild finishes I'll re-run the probe and post results in this thread.
mike: perfect — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
